title: Domain 1 practice: cloud concepts (24%)

kcs.statement: Domain 1 (Cloud Concepts, 24%) has four task statements: benefits of the AWS Cloud, design principles of the Well-Architected Framework, benefits of and strategies for migration, and concepts of cloud economics, so a Domain 1 practice set samples all four.

The six Well-Architected pillars (operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, sustainability) assess a workload, while the six CAF perspectives (business, people, governance, platform, security, operations) organise an organisation's adoption; security is in both lists, so the stem's subject (a workload or an organisation) decides which framework answers it.

problem_ideas: A 12-question Domain 1 set with three items per task statement; score each task statement and name the weakest.
A stem says 'a company wants to train staff and redesign roles before moving to AWS'; decide pillar or CAF perspective, then name it.
A stem says 'reduce the energy footprint of a running workload'; pick the pillar and rule out the CAF platform perspective.
A retailer moves a legacy app to EC2 unchanged to exit a data centre in 60 days; name the migration strategy and the closest wrong R.
A CFO wants to stop buying servers three years ahead; name the economics concept and the cloud benefit it maps to.
Domain 1 is about 12 scored items; compute how many you can miss and still stay at or above 70%.
Classify each miss from the set by task statement and choose which earlier lesson to replay.
